Question B-001-016-011.

Why the correct answer is right: Single sideband on 10.12 MHz falls inside the band where SSB is prohibited.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Frequency modulation (FM) on 29.6 MHz": FM on 29.6 MHz is not the prohibited combination in this item.
- sourceIndex 2: "Morse radiotelegraphy (CW) on 10.11 MHz": CW on 10.11 MHz is a narrow emission and is not the prohibited choice.
- sourceIndex 3: "FT8 on 10.136 MHz": FT8 on 10.136 MHz is not the SSB example prohibited by the bank.
